rule: C-PARK (four fields: context+repro, rationale, impact, recommended next steps+sprint) — never a convenience park

parks.status: DISPOSED by experiment (Reachability Phase 2, U-EXPERIMENT) — the coherence question is ANSWERED (stays parked)
parks.context: The V11 shared-ledger park's coherence experiment ran under criteria hash-checked unchanged (6d49e6b6…). Result: a laundered cross-author search (20 sybils, per-author n=1 → dsr 0.928) earns a WEAKER bar than the unified (n=20 → dsr 0.310) — incoherent under the deployable per-author×domain scoping; the coherent global scoping has a fairness cost (it stiffens a stranger's bar for work they did not do).
parks.rationale: coherence + fairness cannot both hold under a simple scoping; the criterion decided NO.
parks.impact: the shared ledger STAYS PARKED with the evidence attached (a park-disposing SUPERSEDE value); the single-tenant family-honest ledger remains the only aggregation.
parks.nextSteps: reverses only if a scoping is found that is BOTH coherent AND fair (an open research question) AND a genuine stranger has acted (L-2P). Owner: a dedicated tournament/coherence sprint.

parks.context: Combining N INSUFFICIENT strategies into one 'powered' portfolio — possibly legitimate evidence-pooling, possibly deflation-laundering. No ensemble surface exists; building it before the experiment answers is a Halt (A′#7).

parks.impact: until answered, no pooling surface ships; the family-honest ledger stays the only aggregation.
parks.nextSteps: run the designed experiment (synthetic strategies with known correlation ρ; pre-registered: pooling is legitimate IFF the correlation-adjusted pool passes while a pure-noise pool at the same ρ does not). Owner: a dedicated ensemble sprint.

parks.context: The moat's endgame — a family ledger / tournament shared across users. It cannot skip two prerequisites: the statistical-coherence experiment AND a genuine non-author stranger (L-2P).

parks.context: Hierarchical Risk Parity — the research flagged its crypto evidence as MIXED. The fixture test ran under the park's filed criterion hash-checked unchanged (row bf6764cd…): HRP vs equal-weight vs min-variance out-of-sample across 20 rolling windows on multi-asset fixtures.

parks.nextSteps: reverses only if HRP dominates BOTH equal-weight and min-variance out-of-sample across a MAJORITY of windows on a future fixture or real captured-data test. Owner: a portfolio-construction sprint.

parks.status: RESOLVED (Warranty Phase 1 — classified ENVIRONMENTAL; forensics-rwa.json); residual data-dependency folds into P1-1
parks.context: Regenerating RWA-VERDICT.md yielded Decision=DISQUALIFIED while frozen.ts pins NOT-YET. Phase-1 forensics (candidate matrix over 4 environments) DERIVED the cause: Decision=DISQUALIFIED IFF the golden-noise self-test is not green (verdict.ts:332, a fail-safe). The self-test fails in the studio-slim Python-3.9 env because purgedcv (Python-3.11-only) cannot import, and separately because the pinned FRED-gated data/snapshot is absent. Under the reconstructed validated Py3.11 env the golden-noise KEYSTONE reproduces byte-identically (DSR=0.478421, matches purgedcv). The numpy 2.0.2-vs-1.26.4 suspect was ELIMINATED (identical keystone).
parks.rationale: ENVIRONMENTAL, not LOGIC: the RWA finding did not change; the DISQUALIFIED is the fail-safe correctly refusing to certify a verdict computed outside its reproducibility contract. Re-pinning DISQUALIFIED would be the exact F-ENV trap (freezing an unregenerable, environment-broken output) — Halt refused. The pin STAYS NOT-YET; zero re-pins.
parks.impact: The pin is unchanged and correct. The RWA reproducibility environment is now pinned (requirements-rwa-engine.lock: Py3.11 + purgedcv 0.1.2 + scipy 1.17.1 + numpy 1.26.4 + engine stack). Full byte-regeneration of the NOT-YET token is BLOCKED on the absent pinned data/snapshot — a named F-ENV data-absence, not a mystery.
parks.nextSteps: RESIDUAL (folds into P1-1 / the data-plane sprint): with the pinned data/snapshot restored + the full engine venv, regenerate RWA-VERDICT.md end-to-end under requirements-rwa-engine.lock and confirm the NOT-YET token byte-reproduces (the golden-noise keystone already does). Owner: the data-plane follow-up sprint.

parks.id: V14-IDENTITY-PROVENANCE — filed (self-declared, rotation-free; the ratchet-bypass vector named)
parks.status: FILED (the provenance truth stated plainly; owner: the sybil park, unchanged)
parks.context: caller identity is load-bearing in TWO directions and was unspecified: the member-swap RATCHET keys per-declared-author (Pool.composeAndAdjudicate authorId), the rate LIMITER keys per-connection (x-forwarded-for) — and authorId is SELF-DECLARED and rotation-free. A caller who rotates authorId defeats the ratchet (each rotation resets the family of compositions); a caller who rotates connection defeats the limiter. This is the sybil exposure's cheapest form yet (the ratchet-bypass vector).
parks.rationale: the sybil park owns identity ECONOMICS; this sprint STATES the truth plainly (self-declared, rotation-free), keys the ratchet and limiter coherently, and files the bypass vector — building accounts/auth would be prevention theater without the economics, worse than disclosure (A′#11, rejected).
parks.impact: the K-LEGIBLE note gains a provenance sentence rendered where users read (Phase 2); the measured coherence numbers (0.928 laundered vs 0.310 unified) quantify what rotation buys; nothing is hidden.
parks.nextSteps: a future identity/economics sprint prices identity (a cost to declare an author / a connection) so rotation is no longer free; until then the truth is disclosed and the keys documented. Owner: a dedicated sybil-economics sprint.
